text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Okay, where should I buy my<n>groceries
today?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the grocer near the station is<n>doing a super
sale on carrots.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I don't know, though. They'll<n>probably have
another sale at some<n>point...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll just stick with a local place today.<n>I don't feel
like walking too far...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Ines Fujin is pretty<n>fatigued from her
back-to-back races.<n>Revising her race schedule
might be a<n>good idea.
